body: I'm an early-career AI Engineer with hands-on experience building frontend interfaces, backend services, database integrations, and RESTful APIs. I work with JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, and Python, with experience in React, Laravel, and FastAPI.

As a Junior Web Developer at Essentiel CK Childrens Publishing, I develop and maintain School Management System modules, including the Human Resource & Payroll Portal and Registrar Portal. My work supports employee management, payroll processes, records management, and registrar workflows.

I also spearheaded Sentisphere, a web and mobile sentiment analysis system for monitoring student emotional health. I developed frontend and backend components, integrated the database, and documented the system through planning documents, architectural diagrams, and workflow diagrams.
